messages:
aisha.partnerships: Heads-up: EdgeWave asked us to provide SOC attestation + pen-test artifacts for their GovCloud marketplace listing. They want a combined "embargoed release" (partner + Redwood). Need a clear evidence handoff plan: what we publish to the marketplace bucket vs what stays in our secure vault, TTLs on presigned links, and who signs the attestation. Thoughts?

sam.security: I can take the pen artifact ingestion and redaction workstream. Quick Q: marketplace reviewers usually require a redacted bundle (no IPs/PCAPs) plus an internal copy for audits. We should avoid presigning any raw pcap/logs.

aisha.partnerships: Agreed. Plan idea: redacted bundle (tar.gz) -> partner S3 presign for reviewers; full raw artifacts -> encrypted archive placed in Redwood vault with controlled transfer to partner under NDA/embassy handoff.

leo.sis: For SI verification we also need a signed manifest (sha256 + size + path) and a 1-page integration summary (smoke tests, auth flow, basic latency numbers). I can produce the manifest and the smoke-run README.

nora.legal: Legal checklist: embargo attestation (signed by both parties), explicit non-disclosure of vulnerability technical details for the embargo period, and a list of artifact filenames + TTLs before we sign. I need owners to confirm TTLs for each artifact type.

aisha.partnerships: Suggest TTLs: redacted bundle presign = 7 days; debug logs = 48 hours; integration summary (pdf) = 14 days; protected audit archive (no presign) = 90 days retention behind KMS. OK?

sam.security: That looks safe. We should also keep a checksums file in the bundle: checksums.txt with lines like: 

<sha256>  filename

And a manifest signed by CI: manifest.json + manifest.json.sig (GPG).

sam.security: Example presign command we use for GovCloud (placeholder):

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-staging/partners/edgewave/govcloud/redacted-edgewave-2026-03-30.tar.gz --expires-in 604800 --region us-gov-west-1
```

sam.security: Use --expires-in 604800 (7*24*3600) for redacted bundles only. No presigns for raw archives.

leo.sis: Example manifest line that CI will emit (single-line JSON entries):

```
{"file":"edgewave-fw-v2.0.bin","sha256":"b7c3f2...aa12","size":2345678}
```

leo.sis: Manifest will be gzipped and signed: manifest.json.gz + manifest.json.gz.sig. Include instructions for verifier to run `gunzip -c manifest.json.gz | jq .`

(evidence-bot): Staging path created: staging/edgewave/govcloud/ (owner=aisha.partnerships). Redacted bundle upload pending. Auto-delete policy: 14 days by default.

sam.security: Action items: I'll draft the redaction rules (PII, RFC1918/private IPs, internal hostnames, MAC/serial numbers) and run the scrubbing pipeline. Also will create checksums.txt and sign manifest via CI key. ETA: redacted bundle + manifest v1 by 2026-03-28 EOD.

aisha.partnerships: I'll ask partner to nominate an SI witness for raw artifact pickup (no presigns). Partner contact: renee.edge@edgewave.com. Renee to confirm witness identity and shipping instructions by EOD 3/25.

nora.legal: I will prepare two embargo templates: 7-day and 14-day variants. Each will include a signature block for partner + Redwood Eng lead + Redwood Legal. I need exact filenames + TTLs to finalize clauses. Please post them here once decided.

sam.security: We'll replace vuln identifiers with placeholders (VULN-XXXX) in the redacted bundle and keep a mapping file in the secure vault only (mapping is never presigned).

leo.sis: Add a short reproduction snippet to the integration summary: docker-compose snippet + env vars (no secrets) and steps to validate smoke tests. That speeds up marketplace reviewer checks.

aisha.partnerships: Owners & deadlines recap: sam.security = redaction checklist + redacted bundle + checksums by 2026-03-28; leo.sis = signed manifest + integration summary + repro steps by 2026-03-28; nora.legal = embargo templates + attestation wording by 2026-03-26. I'll schedule partner checkpoint for 2026-03-26.

evidence-bot: Note: retention policy set to auto-delete redacted staging artifacts after 14 days. Manual override allowed by evidence-admins group.

sam.security: Request: please allow an archive lifecycle (non-public) of 90 days for audit access, restricted to sec-audit role. I recommend lifecycle rule: move to Glacier within 7 days. Aisha: can you confirm partner acceptance?

aisha.partnerships: Partner agreed to 90-day restricted archive. I'll include in the partnership addendum.

nora.legal: Reminder: no embargoed PR until both parties sign attestation. Legal will not approve release text if filenames or TTLs are missing.

aisha.partnerships: Creating final staging path now: s3://redwood-staging/partners/edgewave/govcloud/ — will notify when sam toggles presign-ready. Keep posting progress in this thread; I'll use it for execution updates.

sam.security: Dropping redaction checklist link when ready. Will ping for witness pickup scheduling.

aisha.partnerships: Thanks all :handshake: — good plan. If anything blocks, DM me directly.
